items.lede: Google has released the September 2026 security patches to address 110 vulnerabilities affecting its Pixel devices, including one zero-day flaw actively exploited in targeted attacks. [...]
items.title: Google fixes actively exploited Android zero-day on Pixel devices

items.lede: The Pixel phone maker said there are indications that a bug in the phone's modem "may be under limited, targeted exploitation."
items.title: Google says some Pixel phone owners were hacked in zero-day attacks
